description: Compose a transaction to cancel an open DEX order

address.description: Source Bitcoin address (must be order creator)

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

offer_hash.description: Transaction hash of the order to cancel

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

name: compose_cancel
